mapper.insert: insert into quiz_practice_session (id, user_id, source, status, total_count, submitted_count, correct_count, current_position, started_at, last_active_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, 0, 0, #{currentPosition}, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())

insert into quiz_practice_item (session_id, user_id, question_id, question_snapshot_json, position_index, state, draft_answer, is_flagged, time_spent_sec, create_time, update_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{questionId}, #{questionSnapshotJson}, #{positionIndex}, #{state}, #{draftAnswer}, #{flagged}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from quiz_practice_session where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId}
select * from quiz_practice_session where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS' order by last_active_at desc, create_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update quiz_practice_item set draft_answer = #{draftAnswer}, is_flagged = #{flagged}, state = #{state}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and state != 'SUBMITTED'

update quiz_practice_item set state = 'SUBMITTED', draft_answer = #{submittedAnswer}, submitted_answer = #{submittedAnswer}, is_correct = #{isCorrect}, pending_review = #{pendingReview}, score = #{score}, time_spent_sec = #{timeSpentSec}, quiz_record_id = #{quizRecordId}, idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, submitted_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and state != 'SUBMITTED'

update quiz_practice_session s set submitted_count = ( select count(1) from quiz_practice_item i where i.session_id = s.id and i.state = 'SUBMITTED' ), correct_count = ( select count(1) from quiz_practice_item i where i.session_id = s.id and i.state = 'SUBMITTED' and i.is_correct = 1 ), last_active_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where s.id = #{sessionId} and s.user_id = #{userId}
update quiz_practice_session set current_position = #{currentPosition}, last_active_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

update quiz_practice_session set status = #{status}, finished_at = sysdate(), last_active_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
